summary: The extracted helper checks the wrong group, so it widens access rather than preserving it.

findings.title: _is_org_admin compares against the permission object, not its root
findings.body: `_can_view_balance` filtered admin groups on `group.get_root().pk`; `_is_org_admin` filters on `group.pk`. A team admin requesting the list for their own team (`OrganizationBankAccountListView.get` with the team as the permission object) now passes `_is_org_admin`, so `get_queryset` skips the connected-accounts narrowing and `get_serializer_context` sets `can_view_balance=True`: they see every account in the org with its balance, and the export carries the balances too. The PR says no behaviour change.

next_steps: Add a test for a team admin on their own team's list.
